lineas.texto: In 1995 Oseola McCarty surprised the University of Southern Mississippi and gained
national renown when she donated $150,000 of her life savings to the university. The
attention and honor that resulted from the gift took her by complete surprise, but to those
who were amazed by her decision to give more than half of her $280,000 estate to a
scholarship fund for African American students, she said, "I don't regret one penny I gave. I
just wish I had more to give."
